contract.alert_logs: only category transitions; bounded snapshot once per sweep; outage category deduplicated
contract.throttle: per worker process; coalesces concurrent execute calls
contract.unknown_age_basis: minimum updated_at among unknown jobs, age of persisted observation; not proof of first uncertainty instant
contract.cleanup_age_basis: minimum cleanup job created_at; not physical deletion latency
contract.blob_overdue_basis: persisted cleanup job deadline_at originally created from write window plus physical_cleanup_target_seconds; retries do not reset it
contract.proof_cleanup_attempt_basis: recovery_descriptor.cleanup_attempts validated numeric representation; not job.attempt_count
contract.blob_cleanup_attempt_basis: attempt_count; currently leased last attempt not exhausted until failed/nonleased
contract.queue_wait_basis: turn: run.created_at+wait with dispatches_used=0; execution: ready.available_at+wait
contract.queued_age_basis: minimum job.created_at among currently ready turn/execution jobs; age of queued job, not exact current-stage waiting duration. queue_wait_expired uses native per-kind timestamps separately.
contract.restore_quarantine_alert: presence of restore_quarantined key in pending jobs, including failed; distinct bounded aggregate signal, not provider readiness or release authority
